title: GatedAccess
description: EXAMPLE / FICTIONAL schema. The made-up 'prove' credential a caller would present to claim eligibility for gated retrieval. In v1 the gate is enforced by the allowlist (sender-AID gating) — caller-presented-ACDC extraction is DEFERRED (see handler.py / Policy.required_schema), so this schema is illustrative only and is NOT yet required to pass the gate.
